sup:70740.text:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our pricing and standard terms for your requirements.

For this item, we can offer a price of €6.10 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To give you some background on our current cost structure, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost, while PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost.

We value our business relationship and look forward to serving you from our extensive product range.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
Thank you for explaining the cost drivers and for your thoughtful offer to walk us through the calculation; we value our long relationship with your family-owned business. The committed volume is our full demand for this part over the term, all with you, and our rising forecast and long contract term provide planning security. Could you review the base price and alloy surcharge with your pricing committee in light of this commitment?

We confirm a binding volume of 23700 units a year for the 36-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 5.84 (po:4500014427-10, po:4500014355-10, po:4500014292-10).
In our call of 2026-09-04 (doc:20260904-70740-M1) you offered to walk us through your calculation; we would welcome that now.
Our forecast for this part is up 1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 4.77 per unit, fixed price, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Dear customer,
Many thanks for your e-mail, and great to hear from you; I went through it right away with our team.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €5.50 per unit, Zahlungsziel 45 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404.
A few words on this from our side.
We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation.
We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We appreciate your commitment to a 36-month contract and the increased volume forecast, which allows us to improve our pricing.
Please note that for a 36-month term, we cannot offer a fixed price and must include the AS-14404 index clause to manage raw material volatility.
We are pleased to offer €5.60 per unit under these terms and would be happy to schedule a meeting to walk you through our cost calculation as requested.
Alternatively, with a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404: €5.60 per unit.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C.
Material accounts for about 45 % of our cost; more detail we do not share.
We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404.
And while we are at it: our whole range is at your disposal, so if there is anything else on your list, just send it over - we are happy to quote.
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Seidl
Inside Sales, Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH

move.subject: Re: Quote from Blankstahl Werdenfels GmbH: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar (Werdenfels)
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your reply and for the step you have taken; we appreciate it.
We appreciate the movement in your last reply and understand that raw-material volatility makes a fixed price over a long term difficult. Our full demand for this part is fixed with you for the contract term, and our rising forecast together with the planning security of a long-term agreement supports a further step toward our proposal. We hope the pricing committee can consider this basis, and would welcome the owner’s offer to walk us through the calculation.

Your on-time delivery was 81.0% in 2026Q3 (sc:70740@2026Q3).

On this basis we propose: EUR 5.06 per unit, price follows AS-14404 on 45% of the price, deadband 0%, payment 45 days net, 36 months, for our full demand of 23700 units a year over 36 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Franz Seidl
